description_full: The Chefs' Warehouse, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, distributes specialty food and center-of-the-plate products in the United States, the Middle East, and Canada. It offers specialty food products, such as artisan charcuterie, specialty cheeses, unique oils and vinegars, truffles, caviar, chocolate, and pastry products and center-of-the-plate products that includes custom cut beef, seafood, and hormone-free poultry, as well as produce and broadline food products comprising cooking oils, butter, eggs, milk, and flour. The company serves menu-driven independent restaurants, fine dining establishments, country clubs, hotels, caterers, culinary schools, bakeries, patisseries, chocolatiers, cruise lines, casinos, and specialty food stores. It markets its center-of-the-plate products directly to consumers through a mail and e-commerce platform. The Chefs' Warehouse, Inc. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Ridgefield, Connecticut.

financial_summary: The Chefs' Warehouse, Inc. is a mid-cap consumer defensive business with a $4.6B market cap on $4.1B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +17% over the past three years and +15% annually across the full decade, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 7% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 25%.

The business throws off $88M in free cash flow — roughly 2 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.79× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, debt is moderate at 3.2× net debt/EBITDA, serviceable in normal conditions but worth watching through a downturn, and interest coverage runs at 3.5×.
Shareholder yield is only 0.3%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 9.5% of the shares, and profit capture is only 0.4× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
